prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ partitionEvidence }`. `partitionEvidence(entries)` accepts an array of records shaped as `{ id, kind, content, ...extra }`, where `id` and `content` are strings and `kind` is `"clip"`, `"document"`, or `"note"`. Return `{ clips, documents, notes }`, placing records into the matching arrays while preserving input order and duplicates. Each returned record must be a new shallow copy so later top-level mutations do not affect the input. An empty array returns three empty arrays. Throw `TypeError` if `entries` is not an array or any record is null, non-object, or lacks valid string `id`, `kind`, or `content` fields. Reject unsupported kinds with `RangeError`. Do not mutate the input array or its records.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
